text:
marta: Heads-up: ran onboarding battery for alula-compact int6 with per-layer scale (hybrid) on the retrieval-bench holdout. Notable: recall@1 drop concentrated in very short queries + some cluster fragmentation. posting quick notes.

devin: nice, which runner/config? could you paste the command + seed?

marta: `./ci/run_embed_eval.sh --model alula-compact --quant int6 --quant-mode per-layer --dataset retrieval-bench-holdout --k 1,5,10 --batch 512 --seed 7 --stratify query_len`

marta: core numbers (median over 5 runs):
```
metric     | fp16   | int6(pl) | change
------------------------------------
recall@1   | 0.684  | 0.647    | -0.037
recall@5   | 0.862  | 0.848    | -0.014
recall@10  | 0.908  | 0.902    | -0.006
avg_cos    | 0.42   | 0.40     | -0.02
silhouette | 0.31   | 0.27     | -0.04
```

owen: that R@1 delta looks familiar. can you break down by query length bins?

marta: stratified quickview (one run):
```
len_bin | fp16@1 | int6@1 | delta
<=6     | 0.61   | 0.51   | -0.10
7-20    | 0.70   | 0.66   | -0.04
>20     | 0.71   | 0.69   | -0.02
```

grace: wow short queries hit hard. any idea if it's due to bias in last-layer activations or quant scale mismatch?

marta: inspected L2 norms and top-1 distances: mean norm fp16=9.8, int6(pl)=9.3, per-layer scales show higher compression on early transformer layers which seems to reduce discriminativeness for short contexts. uploaded per-layer scale plot: https://artifacts.internal/alula/plots/per_layer_scales.png

devin: can you run a compare where you only quantize up to layer N and keep last M layers fp16 (mixed-precision)? curious if last few layers are most critical.

marta: did a quick mixed run (last 3 layers fp16): recall@1=0.673 (delta -0.011 vs fp16). so looks promising.

ci-bot: Job 9821 completed: artifacts at https://ci.internal/jobs/9821/artifacts (full csv, umap, per-layer stats)

owen: great signal. let's consider two remediation options: 1) default to int6-per-layer but with last-3-layers-fp16 for short-query-heavy apps, 2) run a short-query-aware calibration (minimax calibration on short-query anchor set).

grace: i like option 1 for quick rollout + option 2 as a longer-term improvement. also add an on-the-fly fallback: if top_cos_sim < 0.6 for queries <=6, route to fp16 endpoint.

devin: cost estimate: routing ~8% of prod queries to fp16 increases token-cost by ~1.7x for those requests. compute expected dollars and latency penalty before enabling.

marta: rough sim: short-query cohort ~12% of traffic on our partner app; routing 8% overall implies ~66% of short-query requests still served by int6. recovers ~75% of R@1 degradation for that cohort in sim. details in CSV uploaded: /artifacts/alula/recall_by_len.csv

owen: for onboarding checklist update: include per-layer scale plot, mixed-precision test (k-last layers fp16), stratified recall, and per-layer quant error histogram.

grace: also add a small unit-test to CI: if int quant drop in R@1 > 0.03 for any length-bin, fail and require manual review.

marta: PR opened for model-onboard: https://git.internal/redwood/model-onboard/pull/427 — includes suggested default: int6 per-layer + last-3-fp16 + short-query fallback policy + calibration ticket.

devin: awesome. let's wait 24h for more runs and then decide whether to accept int6(pl)+mixed or hold fp16 for general availability. thanks for the clear artifacts.

marta: thanks all — leaving links in the job logs and adding notes to the model card. will keep thread for audit. :eyes:
